text:
Ava: Quick sync 1: I pushed a trimmed launch post draft focusing on the product value props + a small benchmark callout. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-angle-v1
Marco: on it. Can we standardize image aspect ratios? prefer 1200x630 and 400x400 for socials.
Ava: yes. Marco can you add those and include brief alt text?
Marco: will do. alt: 'Redwood dashboard chart showing latency improvement'.
Jen: legal note: remove comparative language to specific vendors; use "improvement" or "reduced latency" and add methodology link for the benchmark line. Also add GDPR consent for webinar form.
Ravi: flagged an inline note in section 3 about the benchmark sample (internal traces). suggest a short footnote with harness details.
Ava: I'll add a footnote and one reproducibility snippet.
Olivia: CTA plan: hero has two CTAs, "Register" and "Read the Benchmarks". We also want a secondary CTA for "Join a live demo" in the body. Which HubSpot lists?
Tom: propose lists: Launch-Registrants (ID forthcoming), Benchmark-Readers, Demo-Requests. I'll create them and share IDs.
Nora: growth ops: we'll need UTM values and a nurture cadence. Suggest utm_campaign=launch_may, utm_content=hero_register|bench|demo.
Ava: timeline ask: copy final by Wed EOD, design by Thu noon, legal signoff by Thu 3pm, staging preview Fri morning. Everyone good?
Marco: Thu noon for assets is tight but doable.
Jen: legal can aim for Thu 2pm if copy is final by Wed night.
Ravi: I'll finish the benchmark appendix Wed afternoon.
Olivia: I'll draft the 3-email nurture sequence for registrants and share subject line variants. Nora can pick during warm-up.
Tom: HubSpot lists created, IDs: 4890, 4891, 4892. DMing the API keys. Redirect endpoints will capture utm_content.
Ava: can PublishBot create a preview once assets and hubspot hooks are in? need an exec link.
PublishBot: staging preview will be generated when you tag /preview in the doc. I can auto-post once assets exist.
Ava: noted 1. small copy nit from Marco: change "See benchmarks" to "Explore benchmarks" to match product voice.
Marco: thanks. Also will include a tiny animated play icon for the demo CTA.
Jen: final legal ask: add consent sentence on the form: "By registering you agree to receive product updates from Redwood Inference." include link to privacy.
Ava: adding consent. Also adding a short dataset disclaimer under the benchmark table per Ravi.
Ravi: added reproducibility snippet: 
```
framework: infer-harness v0.9
model: redwood-2.0
seq_len: 512
batch: 8
hardware: a100
quant: int8
```
Olivia: prepping registration page; will hook GA events and the webinar reminder flow.
Nora: I'll coordinate the nurture send and subject test. plan to pick winner Thu AM.
Ava: great. I'll consolidate tasks into a publish ticket once legal posts the thumbs. Drop any last comments here. :rocket:
